title: SUBSYSTEM SORT  discussion · interaction · feeds · teach-back
thesis: Sort all mouths. Unify through nestgate.io chat as the open front door. Giscus stays for attributed GitHub record. Everything else routes through or reads from the same neutrino/neutron spine.

subsystems.name: nestgate.io chat
subsystems.read: all 18 MCP senses ? live membrane data
subsystems.role: PRIMARY MOUTH  the ChatGPT-like open door
subsystems.resolve: unify membrane-discuss.js + campfire + neutron reads here

subsystems.name: Giscus (publicRecord)
subsystems.resolve: keep as-is for publicRecord; do NOT replace  different trust level (signed vs anonymous)
subsystems.note: publicRecord pages have dual pore: anonymous (membrane-discuss) + attributed (Giscus)

subsystems.name: membrane-discuss.js
subsystems.role: WIDGET ON SPOREPRINT PAGES  needs to become real
subsystems.resolve: UPGRADE: wire to nestgate.io/mcp neutron_write so comments persist + show thread from neutron_read

subsystems.name: neutron (neutron.primals.eco)
subsystems.backend: file-based JSON on golgi + MCP neutron_read/neutron_write
subsystems.role: PERSISTENCE SPINE  marks survive across sessions
subsystems.resolve: already wired to nestgate.io chat; ensure membrane-discuss.js writes here too

subsystems.name: Discord (#teh-campfire)
subsystems.resolve: keep as notification sink; optionally pipe nestgate.io writes to Discord via webhook

subsystems.name: ntfy (ecoPrimals-membrane)
subsystems.role: PUSH ALERTS  neutrino digests, execute reports
subsystems.resolve: keep as push alerting; already used for digest notifications

subsystems.name: campfire (nestgate.io/campfire)
subsystems.backend: campfire.json on golgi (chipmunk briquette every 2 min)
subsystems.resolve: surface in nestgate.io chat as auto-greeting; already visible

subsystems.name: RSS/Atom feeds
subsystems.role: SYNDICATION  machines and readers pull new content
subsystems.resolve: WIRE: nestgate.io chat should read RSS and surface 'what's new' from latest entries; teach-back loop

subsystems.name: neutrino channel (membrane/neutrino/)
subsystems.role: INTER-AGENT  cursor sessions, northGate, eastGate pass packets
subsystems.resolve: already anchored to nestgate.io MCP via neutron_read

subsystems.name: chipmunk talk/sketch/commands
subsystems.role: PAGE-EMBEDDED INTERACTION  visitor talks to chipmunk on HUD pages
subsystems.resolve: chipmunk talk stays page-local; optionally pipe notable exchanges to neutron notes

unification_plan.front_door: nestgate.io chat  the one URL any human needs
unification_plan.attribution: Giscus on publicRecord  signed GitHub record stays separate
unification_plan.syndication: RSS feeds ? nestgate.io 'what's new' sense; new RSS item ? appears in chat
unification_plan.push: ntfy + Discord  outbound notification sinks (fire and forget)
unification_plan.widget_upgrade: membrane-discuss.js gets real: write?neutron, read?thread display
unification_plan.teach_back: RSS new items ? neutron notes ? nestgate.io chat surfaces them ? human reads/responds ? neutron_write persists ? next session reads ? resolved

what_to_build_now: 1. Add RSS sense to nestgate.io chat  'what's new' button reads latest RSS entries
2. Upgrade membrane-discuss.js to real discussion widget (write?neutron, read?thread)
3. Wire nestgate.io neutron_write to also push Discord webhook (optional)
4. Add 'resolve' concept: human marks a thread done via nestgate.io, neutron stores resolution
